channel.title: The Titans of All'Terra — Season 3, Part 1 (Episodes 1-10)
channel.description: Custom fan-made feed: story episodes only, in season order, trimmed for Yoto's 25-track limit. Season 3, Part 1 (Episodes 1-10). Original show: The Titans of All'Terra by Joshua Lorimer.
channel.itunes:author: Joshua Lorimer

item.title: The Crown Before The Storm
item.itunes:title: The Crown Before The Storm
item.description:
Part 1 of our Season 3 Premier!

In this episode our heroes find themselves trapped in the Sol-Realm. The heart of All'Terra. They have finally come face to face with the being who not only created their world, but now seeks to destroy it.

We also take a peek into one of our heroes lives six years into the future.

This season would not be possible if not for listeners like you, and our wonderful supporters at patreon.com/thetitanpod. Thank you all SO MUCH! Welcome to Season 3!

Email: thetitanpod@gmail.com

Twitter: @thetitanpod

Facebook: TheTitanPod

YouTube: The Titans of All'Terra

item.title: We're Back! A D&D Story
item.itunes:title: We're Back! A D&D Story
item.description: It's been six years since the allied kingdoms of All'Terra battled and defeated their false god. The War of Sol changed life in All'Terra, but some things are still the same. Relnor gives heroic speeches, Dalfin jumps head first into danger, Winnie finds new friends in strange places, and Joan continues looking for answers.

item.title: Coming Home Again
item.itunes:title: Coming Home Again
item.description:
Our heroes process the news of Bordu while catching up with one another. Returning to their home kingdom of Lestraad amidst the final day of the Gumble Hexpo, an annual magic/tech show.

And be sure to check out the I Cast Fireball podcast. Their content is family-friendly and Josh had a blast playing with them. You can start from the beginning or skip ahead to episode 56 for Josh's guest appearance.

item.itunes:title: S3E6 Immortal Library, Mortal Danger
